# Zombie Panic in Wonderland (low-poly)

> A free low-poly 3D zombie shooter in the browser, made with three.js and in English: hold a ruined road against five waves of zombies and pumpkin monsters, then the Zombie King; then a crumbling road through a cornfield against zombies, pumpkin monsters and crows, then the Scarecrow King.

## Play

- Address: https://wonderland.cocode.dk/. Click the title screen to start.
- Controls: A / D or ← / → move · mouse aims · hold the left button to shoot · Space dodges · Esc pauses · 1 2 3 or wheel: weapons · R reloads · M sound.
- You have 5 hearts. A zombie strikes when it reaches the road; a pumpkin monster throws pumpkins, which you can shoot down in the air.
- Level 1, the ruined road: five waves of zombies and pumpkin monsters, then the Zombie King, who stomps (a shockwave; step aside or dodge) and summons zombies. Level 2, the crumbling road: five waves with crows as well, then the Scarecrow King, who throws flaming pumpkins and summons crows. Winning level 1 offers Next level.
- Weapons: the Popper (key 1) fires 8 shots a second and never runs out. The Scattergun (key 2) fires 8 pellets a blast, 2 blasts a second, with a magazine of 4 shells. The Pumpkin launcher (key 3) fires 1.5 shots a second, each exploding for 12 hits on every enemy within 2.5 units, with a magazine of 2 rounds. An empty magazine reloads by itself, 1.5 seconds for the Scattergun and 2 for the launcher; R reloads early.
- Crates: a Scattergun crate floats down 2 seconds after wave 2 starts, a launcher crate 2 seconds after wave 4 starts. Shoot one 3 times to take its weapon, in hand, with a full magazine.
- Gas canisters: 2 stand on the field in each of waves 2 to 5. The second hit, or a launcher's blast, blows one up: 12 hits to every enemy within 3 units. It never hurts you.

## WebMCP tools

The game page (`/index.html`) registers WebMCP tools with `document.modelContext.registerTool` when the browser has a registry. Both are read-only and take no input.

- `describe`: returns `{ description }`, one sentence saying what the page is: "A low-poly 3D browser game, Zombie Panic in Wonderland, where you hold a ruined road against the Zombie King and then a crumbling one against the Scarecrow King, each after five waves."
- `get_state`: returns `{ level, screen, wave, score, hearts, enemies, boss_health, weapon, ammo, reloading }`.
  - `level` is `1` or `2`.
  - `screen` is one of `loading`, `error`, `title`, `intro`, `play`, `paused`, `victory` or `defeat`.
  - `wave` is the wave number, 1 to 5.
  - `score` is the points so far.
  - `hearts` is the hearts left, 5 at the start.
  - `enemies` is how many are on the field.
  - `boss_health` is the level boss's remaining hits, `null` until the boss appears.
  - `weapon` is `popper`, `scattergun` or `launcher`, the one in hand.
  - `ammo` is the rounds left in its magazine, `null` for the popper.
  - `reloading` is `true` while it reloads its magazine, otherwise `false`.
